page.layout: One printed page, single text column with a decorative border above the title and a woodcut initial at the start of the chapter text. No marginal notes. Running head at top; page number and catchword/signature absent. Below the text: catchword "versio-" is a line-end hyphenated word, not a separate catchword, so none given.

main_text.head: PARS TERTIA. EX SCRIPTVRIS PROBANTVR NEGATIVA Confessionis nostræ capita; quibus scilicet fide nostra exclusa sunt dogmata præter Dei Verbum à Romanæ communionis hominibus invecta, & constituta.
CAP. I. Fidei, adeoque Religionis nostræ antiquitas, universalitas, & perspicuitas. Unde orta sit nostra cum Romanis controversia.
main_text.p: TQVE ita fidem nostram ex Scripturis demonstravimus. Testimonia, quibus ad eam rem usi sumus, clara sunt, & quidem plæraque diserta, atque propria; quæ tam in Romanis, quam in Genevensibus sacrorum Bibliorum versio-

page.notes: The woodcut initial "T" of "TQVE" is rendered as the first letter of the paragraph. Title and "Cap. I." heading are set in capitals and larger type. The "Q" with the superscript e reads as "Q;" the text "TQVE" is transcribed as printed. Right margin has no notes; the vertical edge at right is the neighbouring page and is omitted.
